theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → Measurable f → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) → (∀ j, A j ⊆ M) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → μHE[n + 1] (M \ ⋃ j, A j) = 0 → (∀ᵐ t, μHE[n] ((M \ ⋃ j, A j) ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0) → (∀ j, ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in A j, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]
